expected_form.problema: Leak on the water chiller's chilled water line: dripping at the valve section, the gauge reads about two pounds below normal and the circuit is pumping air because the expansion tank keeps draining.
expected_form.diagnostico: The two 3/4" ball valves are seized and dripping at the stem, no longer sealing; the 1/2" neoprene hose is crystallized.
expected_form.solucion: Replaced the two 3/4" ball valves and the 1/2" neoprene hose run; refilled the circuit with water and bled the air at the purge valve. The drip stopped and the pressure held steady.
expected_form.notas: Watch the circuit pressure this week; notify the hotel's maintenance chief.

user_utterances.text: Good morning... I'm at the hotel now, in the basement machine room... there's a real ugly puddle next to the water chiller... starting on the leak order, ok?
So look... the chilled water line is dripping right at the valve section... the gauge reads about two pounds under normal... and the circuit is pumping air because the expansion tank keeps draining.

I already closed the main shutoff and drained some off... the two ball valves are seized and dripping at the stem, they don't seal anymore... they're the three quarters ones, both are coming out... and while we're at it the neoprene hose, it's crystallized already.
No, no... the three quarters one!... the big one, the three quarters of an inch one, the three eighths is tiny and comes up short... it's two pieces, three quarters.
That's it now... two pieces, three quarters, correct.
The hose is the half inch neoprene one... just a one meter length, the five eighths one is for the condensate line and that one's fine.
Yes, that one... half inch, one piece.

So I changed the two ball valves, changed out the hose run, refilled the circuit with water and bled the air at the purge valve... it took me... about forty five minutes, no more dripping and the pressure held steady.
Note that we need to watch the circuit pressure this week and that I should tell the hotel's maintenance chief... that's all, send it.
